title: NumPy: elementwise arithmetic and broadcasting
source:
import numpy as np

a = np.array([1, 2, 3])
b = np.array([10, 20, 30])
total = a + b
scaled = a * 2
m = np.array([[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]])
shifted = m + a
col = np.array([[1], [2], [3]])
table = col * a
row = np.array([[10, 20]])
outer = col + row
a += 1

b now refers to a new ndarray.
